title.narrative: Support to Justice Sector Reform in the Kyrgyz Republic: Advancing Probation and Integrated Criminal Justice Information Management (JUST4ALL)

description.narrative: the project promotes humanisation of the criminal justice system in Kyrgyzstan and is geared towards scaling up the countrys capacity to implement its criminal justice reforms in line with international standards and norms as well as best European practices. The action is divided into two main components to address two key elements of the reforms that are indispensable for their sustainability: probation and criminal justice information management.
